title: Mill-Master AI Wiring v2 — De-silo the mill stack onto the PRISM AI reasoning layer
rationale: When the mill-master roadmap was drafted, the PRISM reasoning/Bayesian/self-awareness/MXU engines did not exist yet. They do now (31 reusable AI engines with verified APIs + 2 relevant MXU engines). Only 1 of ~70 mill/5-axis engines (MillingUltimateAIEngine) currently reaches into that stack; every other engine rebuilds a bespoke tiny-AI. This milestone wires the mill stack onto the shared PRISM AI infrastructure, eliminates duplication, and makes each mill capability discoverable + trackable by the MXU layer.
approach: Spike-extract-rollout with explicit exit gates: (0.5) audit the 31 target AI engine APIs; (0) capture legacy-path benchmark baselines; (1) deep-wire MillingMachineIntelligenceEngine as the template with a hard gate before scaling; (2) extract the wiring pattern into a shared helper; (3-14) apply to 12 more engines; (15) MXU effectiveness telemetry; (16) dispatcher E2E + new mill_prism_reason action; (17) docs sweep.

global_contracts.additive_api_only: Every wired engine adds useAI?: "off" | "auto" | "on" as an OPTIONAL request-side parameter. Response schema unchanged when useAI=off. No positional-arg mutations, no required-field additions.
global_contracts.legacy_path_preservation: useAI=off (default) must produce bit-identical output vs pre-wiring behavior. Verified by snapshot test per wired method.
global_contracts.ai_path_behavior: useAI=on produces PRISM-AI-backed output tested against reference values (not diff-identical to legacy). AI path failures fall back to legacy with warning emitted via log.warn.
global_contracts.auto_downgrade: useAI=auto routes to the AI path unless CognitiveBudgetAllocatorEngine predicts a latency-budget breach, in which case legacy is used and a trace event is recorded.
global_contracts.rollback: Each unit ships exactly one commit. Every commit is independently revertible via `git revert` without cascading test failures (guaranteed by additive-only API rule).
global_contracts.claim_protocol: At the start of every unit: post a claim via `.claude/helpers/agent-coordination.mjs post --agent Claude --current <unit-id>`. Abort the unit if the target file has an active claim by another agent.
global_contracts.no_new_physics_constants: All physics constants must continue to come from src/physics/constants.ts. This milestone performs integration work only.
global_contracts.test_legitimacy_rules: No toBeDefined, toBeUndefined, toBeTruthy, toBeInstanceOf as primary assertions. No double casts (X as unknown as Y). No mocks of PRISM AI engines under test. Reference-value assertions or algebraic invariants only.

trace_schema.description: Every useAI=on invocation emits exactly one trace event via log.info with this JSON shape.

fields.auto_downgraded: boolean — true iff useAI=auto chose legacy due to budget
fields.reasoning_branch_count: number | null — treeOfThought branch count when applicable
fields.reasoning_depth: number | null — treeOfThought depth when applicable
fields.hypothesis_count: number | null — hypothesisRanker set size when applicable
fields.fallback_to_legacy: boolean — true iff ai path threw and legacy was used
fields.error_class: string | null — error.constructor.name when fallback_to_legacy is true

baseline_schema.description: U0-BASELINE writes data/benchmarks/mill-master-ai-wiring-baseline.json with this exact structure. Every subsequent unit asserts against it.

baseline_entry_fields.method: string — method name including arg count in parens
baseline_entry_fields.output_schema_hash: string — sha256 of Object.keys(output).sort().join(',') for schema-only comparison
baseline_entry_fields.output_sample: unknown — one example output (for docs only, not for assertions)

baseline_schema.usage: Snapshot tests in U1 through U14 compare useAI=off output_schema_hash to the baseline entry. p95 regressions > global_contracts.latency_budgets_ms.useAI_off_p95_regression_tolerance_ms fail the unit.

api_compat.semver_contract: Additive-only API changes across this entire milestone constitute a MINOR version bump (no major). useAI parameter is OPTIONAL on every method; defaulting to 'off' preserves existing callers bit-identical.
api_compat.deprecated_surfaces: None. This milestone DEPRECATES no public API. Bespoke AI internals (deepReason, scoreStrategies, etc.) remain callable directly — the useAI flag selects their replacement.
downstream_callers_notified: All dispatchers using the 13 target engines
web/src pages that import the engines directly
external consumers via the MCP dispatcher (forward-compatible)

meta_ai_orch.note: No `orchestrate()` — use evaluateReasoning as primary entry

cross_formula_integration.note: Pure-function module — no class; exports physics constants only

capability_census.note: Filesystem-scan based — engines are auto-discovered by existing on disk. No imperative register() needed.

capability_effectiveness.note: Imperative recordUsage(event) is the telemetry hook.

mill_agi_reason.disposition: PRESERVE. Adds new action mill_prism_reason alongside. Semantics: mill_agi_reason = route to MillMasterOrchestratorFacadeEngine AGI type; mill_prism_reason = direct invocation of a specific PRISM reasoning primitive without the facade.

mill_agi_counterfactual.disposition: PRESERVE. U6 (hardening) may call into this existing handler rather than adding a second counterfactual action.

mill_agi_explain.disposition: PRESERVE. U11 (HeadIntelligence explainability) will evaluate whether to extend this handler or use the new mill_prism_reason.

mill_meta_adapt.disposition: PRESERVE. No overlap with new work.
